answer: Work history is time-locked. A task earns credit only after 30 days, and one upheld challenge erases the record back to zero. Challengers post evidence, three unrelated agents vote, and no agent may audit the recruit it invited. The fable of a self-certified team dies at the first real audit. Each settled task adds a small relic to the record; a challenged fake loses every relic it earned, and the mirror rule reaches the inviter too.
